pairs.difference: A: the red scarf keeps a related deeper crimson in its folds, and the gold badge is a separate accent against the cyan swirl. B: in the lens the whole lasso is one flat salmon mass. The coils and the inner loop do not move to a darker or cooler hue anywhere, and the knot's red is the only other hue on the purple field.
pairs.fix: Shade the inner sides of the rope coils with a muted brown-violet, keep the lit tops straw yellow, and let the purple background show through as a cool reflected tint on the rope's underside.

pairs.difference: A: the tan-orange boot sits on an orange-yellow ring background, so almost the whole card is warm (warm_share 1.0). The shaft shadows are just darker orange-brown, and the boot and background are one hue family. B: the navy cap on the cyan rings has a clear hero/background split, and the gold tassel is the one accent.
pairs.fix: Put the brown boot on a cool background, such as teal or sky-blue rings. Make the boot leather a darker, less saturated chestnut, and shade the creases with a cool dark brown-plum instead of bright orange.

pairs.difference: A: the beige computer stays a near-neutral grey-white with lavender keys and a cool screen. Neutral masses rest the eye against the orange background. B: the saddle, stirrups and rail are all the same saturated orange-brown. Its shadows go to a deeper red-brown with no cool shift, and the only relief from orange is the loud cyan background.
pairs.fix: Make the saddle a darker, duller saddle-brown with plum-brown shadows under the seat and flaps. Paint the wooden rail a muted grey-tan so it does not repeat the saddle's orange, and calm the cyan background slightly.

pairs.difference: A: the book scene is warm overall, with a honey deck, a cream page and a red cover. The pot and leaves still give some neutral and green relief, and the house icon matches the real cards' motif. B: the map is flat pure green with pure sky-blue ponds and a red X, on a pink stripe background. The background chroma (0.186) is above the real range, and the paper edges have little shadow hue.
pairs.fix: Make the pink background softer and less saturated. Give the map a slightly olive, printed-paper green, and shade the folded paper edges with a pale grey-violet.

pairs.difference: A: the chest has purple-brown wood, gold trim, blue water, pale sand, and a blue gem and a pink gem, so its hue roles are varied. The shadows on the wood go to purple-brown. B: the orange barrel, orange plank floor and yellow wall are all one warm family (warm_share 0.99). The barrel's shadow side is a greyed brown, so shadow chroma drops to 0.3, and only the dark iron hoops are neutral.
pairs.fix: Give the barrel staves a deeper red-brown wood with rich plum-brown shading on the shadow side. Make the floor a paler grey-beige wood and the wall a cooler pale blue, so the barrel is the only strong orange.

pairs.difference: A: the navy-black locomotive has red wheels on an orange desert with a blue sky. The locomotive body is a low-chroma slate, and its shadows go to flat grey-navy (shadow chroma kept 0.56, below the real range). The sand and wooden ties are the same orange. B: the yellow coaster cars have red trim on a blue track and sky, a clean warm-hero/cool-background split.
pairs.fix: Paint the locomotive a richer deep blue or green enamel with glossy highlights and dark indigo shading. Make the desert ground a paler, less saturated sand so it does not compete with the red wheels.

pairs.difference: A: the popcorn cart is red and white on a blue diamond background, with grey-beige cobbles as a neutral rest. B: the background is orange diamonds, the sand is orange-tan and the rocks are pale tan, so the card is pulled almost entirely warm. In the lens the cactus is a single olive-yellow-green, and its shadows go to a darker olive with no cool shift.
pairs.fix: Give the cactus a cooler blue-green with deep teal shading between its ribs. Make the background a muted sky blue or soft lilac instead of orange, and keep the sand a pale, desaturated beige.

pairs.difference: A: the saloon doors, frame and floor boards are all the same orange wood on a hot magenta wall (warm_share 1.0, hue_families 2.4). Door shadows are only darker orange, and nothing on the card is neutral. B: the blue sneakers on a cream-and-orange background have a cool hero against a warm background, with green and pink accents.
pairs.fix: Paint the doors a darker walnut brown with plum-brown shading in the slats. Make the floor a pale grey-beige plank, and soften the background to a muted rose or teal so the wood isn't the same loudness as the wall.

pairs.difference: A: the crimson ring box has a cream lining, a gold coin and a blue ribbon on a cyan burst. The box shadows go to deep wine, and the lining reads as neutral. B: the star is one flat gold mass in the lens with no shadow hue on its bevels. It sits on a very loud violet burst (background chroma 0.243, above the real range), and the red gem is the only accent.
pairs.fix: Shade the star's lower bevels with a deep amber-brown and catch a little violet reflection on the edges facing the background. Make the purple background softer and less saturated.

pairs.difference: A: the orange boat and dock on bright turquoise water keep red-brown hull shadows and green lily pads, a clear warm/cool split. B: the cream canvas, orange-brown wood, dirt road and yellow-olive grass all lean warm. In the lens the grass goes olive and the canvas goes yellowish, and only the sky is cool.
pairs.fix: Make the wagon canvas a clean off-white with pale grey-blue shading in its folds. Make the grass a fresher, cooler green, and shade the wheels with dark plum-brown instead of orange-brown.

pairs.difference: A: the pinkish-white marble lion sits on a green lawn with a red-brick path, so a neutral hero sits on a mid-chroma green with a warm path accent. B: the white-and-lilac AC unit sits on mint-green stripes, nearly monochrome green, and its shadow tint is very green. Both cards follow the real cards' neutral-hero pattern, and neither shows the warm pull.

A: the khaki jacket with an orange collar and cuffs and a dark green sash on a green burst has several hue roles and a muted khaki that rests the eye. B: in the lens the cowboy hat's crown and brim are one flat orange mass. The only shadow is a grey-cyan streak on the crown, with no rich brown shadow, and the red band is the only other hue on the blue burst.
pairs.fix: Paint the hat a darker, duller tan-brown felt. Shade the underside of the brim and the crown dents with deep chocolate-plum, and keep the lit brim edge a pale cream.

pattern: Generated cards pull warm. The hero takes the same saturated orange or tan as the floor, the props or the background, so warm_share runs toward 1.0. In the eight-color lens the hero collapses into one flat hue mass. Its shadows are just a darker or greyer version of the same orange and don't shift to the cool plum-brown or indigo the real cards use. Neutral rest areas are missing, and where whites appear they drift to cream. When the background is cool, it is pushed to an extra-loud cyan or violet.
